title: Coca-Cola advertisement: “Coke is it!”
summary: A slide with only the Coca-Cola advertising logo: white 'Coke' lettering with a wavy swoosh on a red rounded rectangle, the slogan 'is it!' in large red letters, and the script 'Coca-Cola' logo underneath. No Bible text appears on the slide.

pictures.description: Red-and-white Coca-Cola advertising logo: a red rounded rectangle holding the word 'Coke' in white with a white wave across the bottom, followed by 'is it!' in bold red letters, with the red script 'Coca-Cola' signature logo below on the right.

uncertain: The slide gives no explanation; it follows the slides on the Hebrew word et (alef-tav) and may be a play on 'et' sounding like 'it', but the slide does not say so
